title: Stache TerpTap Portable Vaporizer
description:
The Stache TerpTap Portable Vaporizer combines fun design with powerful performance. Shaped like a beverage tap, this portable vaporizer delivers smooth clouds through its dual-port system, allowing use with both 510-thread cartridges and dry herb coils.

A massive 3000 mAh battery powers six variable voltage settings, giving users full control over flavor and vapor production. The digital display provides clear readings of voltage, resistance, and battery life, while the included crystal-style glass mug adds a playful touch to every session.

Key Features:
3000 mAh Battery: Long-lasting performance for extended use.
Dual-Port Functionality: Compatible with both 510 cartridges and dry herb coils.
Six Voltage Settings: Adjustable from 2.5V to 4.0V for customizable sessions.
Digital Display: Shows real-time voltage, resistance, and battery level.
Tap-Inspired Design: Fun beverage tap look with included decorative glass cup.
USB-C Charging: Fast and convenient recharging with included cable.

Specifications:
Type: Portable vaporizer
Battery Capacity: 3000 mAh
Voltage Range: 2.5V – 4.0V (6 settings)
Compatibility: 510-thread cartridges and dry herb coils
Display: Digital screen with voltage, OHM, and battery readouts
Design: Beverage tap style with decorative glass cup
Charging: USB-C

Kit Includes:
Vaporizer, glass cup, coils, USB-C cable, and cleaning tools

Please note: Two cartridges can run simultaneously, and one cartridge with one dry herb coil, but two dry herb coils cannot be run simultaneously, but one right after the othe
